subject: CoDi kickoff - 4-step conditional generation as our efficiency headline
body:
Team,

CoDi is our Q2 efficiency headline. The method distills a conditional diffusion model out of a text-to-image pretrained model in a single stage - no distill-then-finetune or finetune-then-distill two-step - and on real-world super-resolution it matches 50-step sampling FID and LPIPS with just 4 steps. On text-guided inpainting the parameter-efficient variant actually beats the original 50-step numbers. That's a 10x+ serving-cost story we can put in front of customers.

Milestones: repro of the SR benchmark by March 20; inpainting and InstructPix2Pix conditional settings by April 17; Shipyard demo endpoint and launch review by May 22.

What I need this week from Ivo: staffing split, GPU ask, and a plan for how we publish eval results so other teams can compare against us credibly.

Zofia
